relationships.subject: lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: The computational model suggests that lidocaine and mepyramine caused different alterations of the Nav1.7, 1.8, and 1.9 currents.

key_findings: Topical lidocaine and mepyramine, but not phenytoin, raised perception thresholds versus placebo in healthy volunteers.
A novel threshold-tracking protocol (SENT) can probe differential Nav1.7/1.8/1.9 modulation.
novel_terms: Sodium channel Excitability Nociceptor Testing protocol
